details.receiving: We receive inbound shipments, verify quantities, record discrepancies and register goods in inventory.
details.inspection: We inspect appearance and included components, identifying damage or inconsistencies before dispatch.
details.labeling: We prepare labels, barcodes and product marking according to marketplace requirements.
details.packing: We select suitable packaging and protect products according to category and Wildberries/Ozon rules.
details.storage: We organize stock placement, inventory tracking and careful warehouse storage.
details.dispatch: We pick and prepare shipments and arrange handover to marketplace warehouses.

modelDetails.fbo: We prepare, label, pack and deliver your batch to the marketplace warehouse. The marketplace then stores products and fulfills customer orders.
modelDetails.fbs: We store your inventory, receive picking tasks, prepare orders and hand them over for delivery under marketplace rules.
